item.title: Infosys Limited - Board Meeting Intimation
item.description: Infosys Limited has informed the Exchange about Board Meeting to be held on 17-Oct-2026 to consider results for the quarter ended September 2026.

item.title: Reliance Industries Limited - Acquisition
item.description: Reliance Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding acquisition of 100% stake in a renewable energy company for Rs 4,200 crore.
